customAudit.title: Bridge Infrastructure Condition Assessment
customAudit.subtitle: Analysis of County Bridge Conditions & P3 Program

executiveSummary.overview: Comprehensive analysis of Northampton County bridge infrastructure conditions based on National Bridge Inventory data, TRIP reports, and P3 Bridge Renewal Program outcomes.
keyFindings: 13% of county's 330 bridges in poor condition (43 bridges)
55% in fair condition, only 32% in good condition
33% of 395 miles of roads in poor condition
P3 program addressed 33 bridges but long-term maintenance concerns remain
executiveSummary.fiscalImpact: Continued deterioration projected without adequate funding

findings.title: Bridge Condition Deficit
findings.description: Of Northampton County's 330 bridges, 13% (approximately 43 bridges) are rated in poor condition. In 2021 National Bridge Inventory, 39 bridges were categorized as 'poor' condition.

findings.title: Road Network Deterioration
findings.description: County has 395 miles of roads with concerning condition distribution: 33% in poor condition, 25% fair, 31% good, and only 11% excellent.
sources: TRIP National Transportation Research Nonprofit Report
findings.recommendation: Prioritize road resurfacing program for poor-condition segments

findings.title: P3 Bridge Renewal Program Assessment
findings.description: County initiated innovative P3 (Public-Private Partnership) program to address 33 bridges requiring replacement or rehabilitation. 21 had load-posted weight restrictions.
positiveNotes: County demonstrated initiative with P3 approach
Willowbrook Road Bridge (County Bridge #124) completed January 2025

findings.title: Upcoming Projects
findings.description: Church Road Bridge replacement in Plainfield Township scheduled for Summer 2027 - Fall 2028.

statewideContext.localBridgeDeficiency: 14% of PA local bridges rated poor/structurally deficient

fundingAnalysis.projection: Declining conditions projected without funding increase

controllerFlags.description: 43 bridges in poor condition - recommend annual condition tracking
controllerFlags.requiredAction: Include bridge condition metrics in annual fiscal report

recommendations: Establish annual bridge condition tracking in Controller fiscal reports
Request PennDOT coordination on priority repairs
Evaluate P3 program outcomes and consider expansion
Develop 10-year capital plan for bridge maintenance
